description: Pick up a disposable cup with the left hand and transfer it to the right hand at the drop zone.

context_action.label: observe_qr_for_coordinate_localization
context_action.instruction: Observe the ArUco marker and preserve these context frames for coordinate localization.

left_hand.label: left_hand_during_aruco_localization
left_hand.instruction: Keep the left hand observable while the ArUco coordinate frame is established.

right_hand.label: right_hand_during_aruco_localization
right_hand.instruction: Keep the right hand observable while the ArUco coordinate frame is established.

left_hand.label: left_hand_approach_and_acquire_cup
left_hand.instruction: Approach and acquire the cup with the left hand.

left_hand.label: left_hand_transport_cup_to_drop_zone
left_hand.instruction: Transport the acquired cup to the drop zone with the left hand.

left_hand.label: left_hand_release_cup_at_drop_zone
left_hand.instruction: Release the cup at the drop zone with the left hand.

left_hand.label: left_hand_retreat_from_drop_zone
left_hand.instruction: Retreat the left hand after releasing the cup.

right_hand.label: right_hand_wait_at_drop_zone
right_hand.instruction: Wait at the drop zone with the right hand; do not label waiting as acquisition or transport.

right_hand.label: right_hand_receive_arriving_cup
right_hand.instruction: Receive the arriving cup with the right hand.

right_hand.label: right_hand_guide_or_stabilize_cup
right_hand.instruction: Guide or stabilize the cup with the right hand while placement is completed.

right_hand.label: right_hand_retreat_from_drop_zone
right_hand.instruction: Retreat the right hand after placement is complete.

atomic_actions.label: approach_and_acquire_cup
atomic_actions.instruction: Approach and acquire the disposable cup.

atomic_actions.label: transport_cup_to_drop_zone
atomic_actions.instruction: Transport the acquired disposable cup to the drop zone.

atomic_actions.label: place_and_release_cup_in_drop_zone
atomic_actions.instruction: Place and release the disposable cup in the drop zone.

atomic_actions.label: retreat_from_drop_zone
atomic_actions.instruction: Retreat both hands from the drop zone as observed.
